 "data": "flowchart TD
 subgraph Atlasctl [\"Atlasctl - Platform Management Tool\"]
 A_text[\"Workload Lifecycle:<br/>new / enable / disable / seed / delete / status / list / logs / backup\"]
 end

 subgraph CICD [\"CI/CD - GitHub Actions\"]
 C_text[\"act or cloud / self-hosted runner<br/>ci: ci-base ➔ ci-middleware ➔ ci-workload<br/>build: atlasctl, seal\"]
 end

 subgraph GitOps [\"GitOps - Argo CD\"]
 G_text[\"Layers: base / security / storage / delivery / observability\"]
 end

 subgraph Workloads [\"Workloads\"]
 W_text[\"Seal (Example Microservice App)<br/>seal-api / seal-ui / seal-worker / dlq CronJob\"]
 end

 subgraph K8s [\"Kubernetes Runtime - Talos Linux\"]
 direction TD

 subgraph K8s_R1 [\" \"]
 direction LR
 k1[\"Cilium<br/>CNI\"] ~~~ k2[\"LB (Cilium)<br/>IPPool\"] ~~~ k3[\"Gateway API<br/>Envoy\"] ~~~ k4[\"Argo<br/>Rollouts\"] ~~~ k5[\"Kyverno<br/>(Policy)\"]
 end

 subgraph K8s_R2 [\" \"]
 direction LR
 k6[\"Vault +<br/>ESO\"] ~~~ k7[\"KEDA +<br/>Metrics\"] ~~~ k8[\"LINSTOR<br/>Storage\"] ~~~ k9[\"CNPG<br/>PG+Redis\"] ~~~ k10[\"MinIO<br/>(S3)\"]
 end

 subgraph K8s_R3 [\" \"]
 direction LR
 k11[\"Velero<br/>(DR)\"] ~~~ k12[\"Trivy<br/>Operator\"] ~~~ k13[\"Cosign<br/>Sign\"] ~~~ k14[\"Snapshot<br/>(Ctrl)\"] ~~~ k15[\"Cert-manager<br/>(TLS)\"]
 end

 obs[\"Observability:<br/>Prometheus / Grafana / Alertmanager<br/>Loki / Tempo / Grafana Alloy / Hubble\"]

 K8s_R1 ~~~ K8s_R2 ~~~ K8s_R3 ~~~ obs
 end

 subgraph Infra [\"Infrastructure - Terraform / OpenTofu\"]
 direction TD
 incus[\"Incus / Talos VMs\"]
 vip[\"VIP (HA)\"]

 subgraph Infra_Nodes [\" \"]
 direction LR
 subgraph CP [\"Control planes\"]
 direction LR
 cp1[\"cp-1\"] ~~~ cpn[\"cp-n\"]
 end
 subgraph Workers [\"Workers\"]
 direction LR
 w1[\"worker-1\"] ~~~ wn[\"worker-n\"]
 end
 zot[\"Zot cache<br/>images\"]

 CP ~~~ Workers ~~~ zot
 end

 incus --> vip --> Infra_Nodes
 end

 Atlasctl --> CICD --> GitOps --> Workloads --> K8s --> Infra

 style K8s_R2 fill:none,stroke:none
 style K8s_R3 fill:none,stroke:none
 style Infra_Nodes fill:none,stroke:none",
